objective: Replace core-wear-protocol's ScaffoldPlaceholder with the real phone/watch contract, as pure Kotlin/JVM (no Android, no other project module -- see the module's own build.gradle.kts header). Deliver: (1) `CaptureEnvelope`: protocolVersion Int, captureId String (UUID text), rawText String, capturedAtEpochMillis Long, source String (constant equal to the name of core-domain's CaptureSource.WATCH_VOICE, WITHOUT depending on core-domain), sourceSurface String, optional speechConfidence Double, optional alternatives List<String>. (2) `CaptureAck`: protocolVersion, captureId, status enum {RECEIVED, SAVED, NEEDS_REVIEW, FAILED_RETRYABLE, FAILED_FINAL}, optional canonicalActivityName, optional occurredAtEpochMillis, needsReview Boolean. (3) Path constants: a capture DataItem path prefix (one item per captureId, e.g. /capture/<captureId>) and an ack message path (e.g. /capture-ack). (4) Compact JSON encode/decode via kotlinx.serialization (catalog aliases libs.kotlinx.serialization.json and plugin alias libs.plugins.kotlin.serialization; add them to this module's build file, no literal versions). Decoding is strict and total: it returns a result type, never throws to the caller; failures are a payload-free kind enum (UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, MALFORMED, BLANK_TEXT, TEXT_TOO_LARGE, INVALID_ID) -- a failure must be structurally unable to carry the payload text (AGENTS.md #11). Define a sensible max rawText size constant and document it. Encoding validates too (blank/oversize text refused). (5) `OutboxState` (CREATED, QUEUED, SENDING, PHONE_RECEIVED, PROCESSED, ACKNOWLEDGED, RETRYABLE, FAILED) and a pure transition function over events (queued, sendStarted, sendFailedTransient, sendFailedPermanent, ackReceived(status)) per WATCH_SPEC section 4: legal edges succeed, illegal edges return a typed refusal, a duplicate/late ack in a terminal state is idempotent (no state change, not an error), RETRYABLE may return to SENDING, ack statuses map to PHONE_RECEIVED/PROCESSED/ACKNOWLEDGED/RETRYABLE/FAILED sensibly (document the mapping in KDoc). Delete ScaffoldPlaceholder.kt and ScaffoldPlaceholderTest.kt. Write JVM tests for all of it.
non_goals: No Android or Play Services dependency; no dependency on any project module.
No persistence, no Data Layer calls, no UI -- those are WC1.2-WC1.5.
Do not touch app-phone, app-wear, core-domain, core-data, core-speech or docs.
Do not edit gradle/libs.versions.toml (aliases for serialization already exist); no literal versions in the build file.
acceptance_criteria: core-wear-protocol has no Android dependency and no project-module dependency; no literal versions in its build file.
Round-trip tests for CaptureEnvelope and CaptureAck; rejection tests for unsupported version, blank text, oversize text, malformed JSON, invalid captureId.
Decode/encode failures are a payload-free kind enum; no failure type can hold the raw text.
Transition tests cover every legal edge, illegal edges are refused with a typed result, a duplicate ack in a terminal state is idempotent, RETRYABLE can resume SENDING.
ScaffoldPlaceholder.kt and its test are deleted; no logging call exists in the module.
